_comment: Curated list of project ideas that have actually been built. This is maintained by hand (the daily routine never edits it). Two entry shapes are supported: (1) a 'ref' to an existing idea by {date, n} to promote it into the Implemented section, optionally overriding fields and adding url/repo; (2) a fully standalone project. See ideas/SCHEMA.md.

projects.notes: Built in one session with zero runtime deps beyond React: verified Machado 2009 CVD matrices in linear sRGB, OKLab confusion detection, hue-preserving contrast fixes, PNG/print reports, 11 unit tests. Also deployed to GitHub Pages at pisanuw.github.io/c1.

Built in one session: five algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Greedy, A*) emitting a single event trace consumed by both the canvas renderer and the narrator. Narration is rule-based instead of the suggested Claude API calls, so it is free, offline, and always matches the algorithm state. Side-by-side compare mode, RLE share links in the URL hash, seeded maze generator, 20 vitest cases.

In progress since 2026-08-20. CODE COMPLETE and pushed to Claude-capstone/schema-storyteller (main): client-side SQL/Prisma/JSON-Schema parser, entity-relationship narrator, rule-based reviewer, Markdown export; 71 vitest tests, 88.88% coverage; lint/typecheck/build all green (re-verified 4th run). DEPLOY BLOCKED, 4th run (2026-08-20), blocker unchanged and owner-controlled, not code. (1) GitHub Actions Deploy run #20 (with the siteId pin) now reaches the Netlify site directly and fails with a SINGLE clean error 'Unauthorized: could not retrieve project' = the repo secret NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN is stale/invalid. Same token failure hits accessibility-lens, emoji-lingua, and mult-streak-edge in the same run. (2) From this session the MCP-relayed CLI deploy (npx @netlify/mcp ... --proxy-path) uploads then dies with '403 Forbidden'; direct api.netlify.com and *.netlify.app CONNECTs also 403. Egress policy denies Netlify hosts, so no deploy can originate here. The Netlify MCP connector still authenticates server-side (account is healthy, site 0fe0b047-2ef4-40ec-aded-1a35dc15e076 exists with a current deploy), so ONLY the stored CI token is stale. ACTION NEEDED FROM OWNER: rotate NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN in the Claude-capstone repo secrets, then re-run the Deploy workflow; run #20's siteId pin means it will succeed and finish steps 5-7 for this project and unblock the other 3 sites. Deliberately NOT applying the 'failed twice, abandon it' rule: it exists to drop unbuildable ideas, whereas this one is finished, tested, and pushed, and any replacement would hit the identical deploy wall. Separately, the Render service mult-streak is suspended ('cannot deploy suspended service').
